referencesNotShipped.use: form: thin pale ring beam, slender round columns, glazed hall front with aluminium bands, dark stage house

referencesNotShipped.source: The Long Center, H-E-B Terrace information

referencesNotShipped.use: form: tented canopy, eave sweeps, colonnade, solar

referencesNotShipped.source: AIA Austin Guide to Austin Architecture: Auditorium Shores; Fannie Davis Town Lake Gazebo
referencesNotShipped.use: lawn/trail character; gazebo folded octagonal canopy with oculus

referencesNotShipped.source: City of Austin trail directory / Butler Trail pages; The Trail Conservancy map

limitations: Long Center, Palmer Events Center, their parking garage and the gazebo are reference-guided approximations placed on measured anchors, not 1:1 models; the Long Center ring circle fit has a ~3 m median residual
ponds are 2017 LiDAR water voids with an estimated level; docks are 2023 City polygons; no animated water
park layout follows 2023 City ground classes (the 2008 plan only informs names); playground paint, art and small furniture are not modelled
the river reach is flight-only (water never lands); the South First bridge stays visual-only
the parking garage height is the 2017 LiDAR bulk roof; the City 2023 MAX_HEIGHT for its footprint is its peak and is not used for the deck
